ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.eLogix_Bypass_Validation_Rules), AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Settled"), OR(ISBLANK(Settlement_Date__c), ISBLANK(Approved_Amount__c), ISPICKVAL(Resolution__c, "Pending")) ) )
